name: A liberation battle's turns and banners
result: BN5 in romlab (mission 1's first liberation battle, a state from the PR #202 session): BattleState +7 0 until the first Custom screen opens, then 1. BN5's code read: 0x08007954 shows FINAL TURN! (0x10) from +7 3, else TURN n START! (0x0C, n = +7); 0x08008BD2, the Custom screen asked for, from +7 3 sets the loop's phase 0x18 (0x08007C24: TIME UP!, LIBERATE FAILED!); 0x08007A50, the win, 1 TURN LIBERATE! (0x90) where +7 is 1, else LIBERATE SUCCESS! (0x58). BN6 (Gregar) keeps the message table whole (0x0801EF84) but not the rules. With BN6's loop answered by hooks, a dark layer's battle (--dev dark,god, BN5's ROM): TURN 1 START!, TURN 2 START!, FINAL TURN!, the third gauge full: TIME UP!, LIBERATE FAILED!, back on the board with the panel dark and no results screen; with onehit a first-turn win showed 1 TURN LIBERATE!.
meaning: BN5's liberation battle runs on BN6's own loop with BN6's own banners: four hooks and its draw, no code moved.
